北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴好，体感偏凉风力不小，注意添衣保湿哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Beijing, but it feels cool with a noticeable breeze. Remember to layer up and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云气温较低，北风吹着体感 2℃，请多穿衣物保暖呀！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and chilly in Cixi, feeling like 2℃ with a brisk north wind. Please dress warmly!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云有凉意，体感 6℃ 左右，外出记得加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and a bit cool, feeling around 6℃. Don't forget an extra layer when you go out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 14℃ 挺舒服，但早晚温差大，注意别着凉！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Guangzhou, a comfy 14℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and night to avoid catching a cold!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天不冷，体感 19℃ 挺暖和。不过湿度高，注意防潮！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and mild in Shenzhen, feeling a warm 19℃. High humidity though, so be mindful of dampness!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天有寒意，体感只有 4℃，出门务必多穿，小心着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and quite cold in Hangzhou, feeling only 4℃. Make sure to bundle up when you go out to avoid catching a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 6℃ 偏凉，风力 2 级，记得加衣并注意补水哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and cool in Nanjing, feeling like 6℃ with a light breeze. Remember to layer up and stay hydrated!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 12℃ 舒适，但别忘了添衣，早晚微凉！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and comfortable in Chengdu at 12℃. Don't forget to add layers, as mornings and evenings can be cool!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 3℃ 湿冷，请务必多穿厚衣，注意防寒保暖！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Overcast, damp and very cold in Wuhan, feeling 3℃. Please dress in thick layers to stay warm and prevent catching a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 5℃ 偏冷，风力 2 级，注意防风保暖和保湿哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cool in Xi'an, feeling 5℃ with a light breeze. Remember to dress warmly, stay hydrated, and protect from wind!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 13℃ 比较舒适，但湿度偏高，注意防潮哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and comfortable in Chongqing at 13℃. Humidity is high though, so be mindful of dampness!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阵雪，体感 -8℃ 寒冷，请全副武装，注意防滑防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Light snow in Harbin, feeling a freezing -8℃. Bundle up completely, and be careful of slippery surfaces and frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 2℃ 寒冷，风力 3 级，请注意防风保暖和保湿！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and cold in Shenyang, feeling 2℃ with a brisk breeze. Remember to stay warm, protect from wind, and moisturize!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 15℃ 舒适，早晚温差大，记得加衣保湿哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and comfortable in Kunming at 15℃. Big temperature swings, so remember to layer up and stay hydrated!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 12℃ 舒适，但风力不小，请注意保暖防风！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and comfortable in Xiamen at 12℃, but there's a noticeable wind. Remember to stay warm and protect from the wind!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 2℃ 偏冷，风力 3 级，请注意防风保暖呀！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cool in Qingdao, feeling 2℃ with a brisk wind. Remember to dress warmly and protect from the wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴好，体感 3℃ 寒冷，风力 3 级，请注意防风保暖和保湿！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and cold in Dalian, feeling 3℃ with a brisk wind. Remember to stay warm, protect from wind, and moisturize!
